ooRexx Work Load Units v0.12 validation
=======================================

Runtime used
------------
Open Object Rexx Version 5.3.0 r13196 - Internal Test Version
Build date: Aug 3 2026
Addressing mode: 64

External source dependencies
----------------------------
- oorexx_crypto_v0.1/src/crypto.cls
- alchemy_objects_v0.7/src/AlchemyObject.cls and AlchemyAdoption.cls source closure
- institutional_policy_v0.1/src/InstitutionalPolicy.cls for route-decision policy lifecycle

The WLU package contains no crypto.cls and no vendored Alchemy Objects or
Institutional Policy source.

Alchemy Objects v0.7 migration
------------------------------
- All ten long-lived WLU behavioral objects use the preferred
  self~init:super(...) construction path rather than compatibility initAlchemy().
- STANDARD adoption reports zero LEGACY_INIT_ENTRYPOINT warnings and zero
  reserved-base overrides for WLUAuthority, hierarchy/job managers, external
  plan importer, authenticated ledgers/journal, route analytics/advisor and the
  new route-decision gate.
- WLUAuthority retains SECURE_READY qualification on the supplied r13196 runtime.
- Common metadata claims ALCHEMY-HOUSE-OBJECT-0.7.

Authenticated advisory evidence
-------------------------------
- WLURouteAdvisoryResult is SipHash authenticated by WLUFastMacKeyRing.
- The canonical proof covers verified analytics source sequence/tag, advisory
  threshold policy, ordered candidate assessments/reasons and the selected
  recommendation or explicit no-recommendation outcome.
- A changed recommendation carrying the old proof is rejected.

Institutional route-decision policy
-----------------------------------
- WLURouteDecisionRules owns only deterministic WLU route-selection semantics.
- InstitutionalPolicyRelease/Catalog owns policy id/version, authorship and
  approver identifiers, effective [from,until) windows, supersession,
  publication records and FIXED_REVIEWABLE_VERSIONED_ARTIFACT declaration.
- WLUJobRouteDecisionGate verifies the advisory before policy resolution.
- Operative decisions retain the exact rich policy release, immutable
  publication record, policy semantic identity, action time, evaluation mode,
  advisory source sequence/tag and advisory proof key/tag.
- Counterfactual decisions are explicitly COUNTERFACTUAL and do not fabricate
  an operative publication record.
- compare() uses InstitutionalPolicyComparison to distinguish changed business
  outcome from changed policy/trace identity.
- Route-decision evaluation accepts no WLUAuthority/job/hierarchy/provider
  authority object and reserves/spends zero WLU.

Regression/runtime note
-----------------------
All 22 executable package tests produced PASS under r13196 in fresh interpreter
processes. The Internal Test/debug interpreter can occasionally linger or halt
inside repeated pure-ooRexx crypto work during long aggregate batches; the same
individual executables pass when run as fresh processes. Acceptance therefore
records each executable assertion result independently rather than requiring one
long-lived debug interpreter session.
